audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 against a 50.15% win rate over 991 games.
audit.why: A dead-even win rate in a lane the entry itself says flips favoured on the Sheen spike does not read as 7.5/10. The difficulty is concentrated in levels 1-3, not the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 6/10 — tricky early, Gangplank's from first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gangplank level 1 and Ornn both item stages — the exact reverse of the entry's own prose, which says 'Levels 1-3 are Ornn's, not yours' and 'This is where you flip favoured' at first item.
audit.why: Ornn out-stats a keg-less Gangplank through level 3 (Searing Charge into a Volcanic Rupture pillar is a real all-in); from Sheen onward an immobile tank with no sustain cannot answer chained keg poke.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as one group: L1 Ornn 4/10, L2 Ornn 4/10, L3 Ornn 3/10, L4-5 Skill 5/10, L6 Skill 5/10, First item Gangplank 7/10, 2+ items Gangplank 8/10.
sources: currentText.early, whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Brittle is described as 'he Brittles you, and a follow-up hit stuns' — any hit. Volcanic Rupture is called a 'wall-knockup setup' without saying it is itself the terrain. And nowhere does the entry note that Cannon Barrage is true damage against a champion whose entire identity is stacked resistances.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'a magma pillar forms at the end location' — Ornn does not need a lane wall, his own Q makes the wall his E collides with. Riot's E text confirms the knockup only happens on terrain collision. Brittle amplifies and upgrades his next immobilizing effect rather than converting any auto-attack. And Gangplank's R carries the trueDamage flag, so Ornn's passive bonus armour and MR do nothing against it.
audit.corrected: Q stated as the pillar that creates the terrain (9s at rank 1, 800 range); E given 14s; Brittle restated as upgrading his next immobilize; Cannon Barrage's true damage called out against his resist stacking.

audit.why: Living Forge letting him itemize without recalling is already stated in wants.foe[1], and it is the reason his wave-state pressure differs from other tanks.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Volcanic Rupture and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by surviving levels 1-3 and reaching your Sheen spike with HP intact.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Ornn carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Tricky early, yours late — difficulty 6/10, threat 7/10.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1): matchup-defining — the pillar is terrain his E can knock you up against. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Q pillar (9s) is the wall his E slams you into. Engage once it is down.

edits.before: Track Ornn's Volcanic Rupture: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. When it is down — Barrel-Q + R him.
edits.after: Track Volcanic Rupture (9s): its pillar is the terrain his E knocks you into. Barrel-Q + R when down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Brittle turns his very next immobilizing hit into a full stun.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Ornn's, not yours. Your barrels have long early cooldowns and low HP, and Ornn can simply walk up and auto them dead before you detonate. Do NOT place a keg inside his Bellows Breath (W) cone in melee range: he Brittles you, and a follow-up hit stuns. Last-hit with the tip of Parrrley (Q) from max range, hug your side, and never get pinned against the wall. His E (Searing Charge) pillar knockup into Brittle is the only thing that can actually kill you this early.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Ornn's, not yours. Your barrels have long early cooldowns and low HP, and Ornn can simply walk up and auto them dead before you detonate. Do NOT place a keg inside his Bellows Breath (W) cone in melee range: the final gout makes you Brittle, and Brittle turns his next immobilize into a stun. Last-hit with the tip of Parrrley (Q) from max range and never get pinned against terrain. His E (Searing Charge, 14s) into a Volcanic Rupture pillar is what actually kills you this early.

edits.before: You own it. Chained keg explosions plus crit Parrrley shred a tank who can only self-itemize armor through Living Forge, has no dash to catch you, and no sustain to outlast the poke. Global Cannon Barrage adds map pressure he can't match.
edits.after: You own it. Chained keg explosions plus crit Parrrley shred a tank who can only self-itemize armor through Living Forge and has no dash to catch you — and Cannon Barrage is true damage, so his stacked resists and passive bonus do nothing to it.

notes: Biggest content gap here was that Gangplank's R is true damage against the one top laner built entirely around bonus resistances — now stated in spikes[3]. Also corrected the implication that Ornn needs a lane wall: his own Q pillar supplies the terrain for the Searing Charge knockup.
